scope: Research-only audit of all nine directed legacy can_break_metal(_throw) exit edges, plus native 742 co-target. No production edits, source/route acceptance, or starting-inventory removal is authorized by this report.
map_review: Actual full composite pixels inspected for141,205,707,708,742 and adjacent706,704,712,740,741. Coordinates use16 pixels/tile. Composite maps omit final two native rows; native 141 full grid supplied independently. Native objects, not sprite resemblance, identify ability sources.

source_policy_contract.vanilla_or_excluded: A verified source supplies its native grant only when the matching permission is available under Ability Gating. Permission is not equipped ability.
source_policy_contract.deterministic_shuffle: Resolve the actual grant of each listed physical source under final policy; accept only its exact reviewed provider and capture/carry/move sequence. A source behind its gate cannot bootstrap access.
source_policy_contract.live_random_finite_enemy: Possible metal output is not guaranteed. A multi-output pool or positive Normal weight is not a finite source guarantee. No enemy in this report has a documented renewable retry loop.
source_policy_contract.live_random_renewable_statue: Existing retouch fairness may be reused only for independently reachable permanent statues and explicitly enabled documented retries; a successful output must then be carried through the exact route. Enemy no-ability weight does not apply to statue mask.
source_policy_contract.throw: Separate physical-object action. Need actual equipped Throw, a validated grabbable object at capture position, and a trajectory from that position. No walking/jumping held ammo to arbitrary positions, no cross-room held-object transport, no same enemy used both for swallowing and throwing.
source_policy_contract.master: No ordinary enemy pool or hub statue is presumed to supply Master.
source_policy_contract.room_instances: Do not infer persistent broken F5 or renewed enemies on a door transition. AI may retain a room instance.
